items.html: Now the reason why these two Names of Elohim are changed and become Metzpatz and Metzpatz, we have already begun to explain above. And this is its complete meaning. Know that the eight white ways are drawn from the head through the sides of the face, as above, and they are two Names of YHVH. And those two Names shine in these two corners; and especially when they withdraw to the sides, as above. Then, even though the corners are Elohim, they become Names of YHVH like the whitenesses, except that they are interchanged in Metzpatz and Metzpatz, and not literally YHVH, because they are of the aspect of Elohim, as mentioned above.
